label: Why a plain AND fails
subgoals: Gate the clock with an AND of clock and enable
Show that an enable change during the high phase creates a runt or spurious pulse
Note that enables launched by the same clock change during the high phase

label: The latch-based ICG
subgoals: Latch the enable while the clock is low
AND the latched enable with the clock to pass whole pulses
Time the enable with clock-gating setup and hold checks

label: Where and when gating pays
subgoals: Replace a bank's hold multiplexers with one gate on its clock
Estimate the saving from the fraction of cycles the enable is off
Balance gate placement in the tree against enable timing
